seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Cincinnati Bengals at Pittsburgh Steelers at Pittsburgh Steelers +1.9 with a 44.4 fair total. Cincinnati Bengals wins 57% of simulations. Model status INVESTIGATE. Research, not picks.
excerpt: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#11 in EPA per play), while Pittsburgh Steelers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#18 in EPA allowed per play). EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Pittsburgh Steelers…

research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 31 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.
market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at BetRivers and Pinnacle on 2026-09-22, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live. It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#11 in EPA per play), while Pittsburgh Steelers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#18 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Pittsburgh Steelers +1.9 with a fair total of 44.4 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Pittsburgh Steelers pass defence, which sits +0.055 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

Both starters are confirmed by the schedule feed, so the quarterback term is priced from the learned value of the two players actually named.
The learned QB layer is identity-keyed and value-only: it says how a quarterback has played, never how he is feeling, and it knows nothing about a start nobody has announced.
